control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices
dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: corrective action - critical safeguard at P-4102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on P-4102, ACC-4102 and HX-4120 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically proving overpressure protection is in service. P-4102 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 13 March 2012 a corrective action on P-4102, ACC-4102 and HX-4120 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility was reviewed against the critical safeguard it was raised to restore.
